title: Business Value, Metrics & ROI
body: Turning DITL findings into credible value: value architecture, translation paths to cost, revenue and risk, metrics, evidence tiers, recapture rate, and the Value Calculator
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Structure a business case with the four-part value architecture.
Translate time savings into cost, revenue or risk impact.
Apply the recapture rate and present ranges with labeled evidence.
Define metrics with baseline, target, system of record and owner.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-107. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
